title: Cotton Whitefly Advisory
content: Monitor whitefly population regularly. Install yellow sticky traps. Use only CIBRC-approved insecticides when ETL is reached.

title: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus
content: Use virus-free seed, remove infected plants and control whitefly vector.

title: Cotton Low Soil Moisture Advisory
content: Monitor soil moisture regularly. When soil moisture is low, follow the recommended irrigation schedule for the crop and local soil conditions. Avoid unnecessary over-irrigation.
